notes: Source paths are relative to the repository root and point into the git-ignored source vault (images/, videos/).
Originals are never modified. `npm run media:ingest` writes web masters to src/assets/media/<set>/<id>.jpg and videos/posters to public/media/video/.
crop = {x,y,w,h} in display-orientation pixels of the ORIGINAL (after EXIF rotation). Omit for no crop.
excluded items are documented but never processed.

status: included | needs_review | excluded. needs_review = usage rights or provenance unconfirmed → excluded from production builds by src/data/media.ts (needsReview) and enforced by scripts/check-links.mjs. excluded = documented, never processed. Source files are NEVER deleted or modified.
